_comment: Human-readable mirror of the harvest adapters. The AUTHORITATIVE copy lives in chatbox/supabase/functions/cpl-news-harvest/index.ts — edit there and redeploy; keep this in sync for reviewability.

google_news_rss.note: Workhorse. Free, no key. when:30d recency window, 8 items/query.

queries.q: "credit for prior learning" California community colleges
"credit for prior learning" California apportionment OR funding
California community colleges veterans "military credit" OR "JST"
California community college "earn and learn" OR upskilling workforce
California budget community colleges "prior learning" OR workforce
"credit for prior learning" college (CAEL OR ACE OR workforce)

gdelt_doc_2.note: Free, no key. 45d window, breadth across outlets.

cccco_press.note: Scraped listing page; Claude filters for CPL relevance.

bluesky.note: The one open social API (AT Protocol public search, no auth).
queries: credit for prior learning community college

manual_requests.note: public.cpl_news_requests — anon can suggest a URL via the tab. How CLOSED socials (LinkedIn / X / Facebook / Instagram) enter: the function reads the URL's OpenGraph preview, no scraping. Closed-platform APIs are paywalled/forbidden in 2026.

closed_social_status_2026.x_twitter: No free tier (pay-per-read since Feb 2026). Manual path only.
closed_social_status_2026.linkedin: Public API closed; ToS bans automated collection. Manual path only.
closed_social_status_2026.facebook_instagram: No public search API. Manual path (OpenGraph) only.
